one_line: Make each feature a short clip with one red key word, and reveal a hidden feature mid-Reel.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot of a styled living room, a beige ride-on toy half hidden under the coffee table, slow push-in. Voiceover (transcript): "מה זה שם בסלון שלי? אקססוריס חדש?" Red words one by one: "שם", "אקססוריז", "חדש?", "הבימבה".
q1_hook.why: A question about an odd object in a calm room, said and written at once (H5, H6, T3), is answered by 0:03. But the first 4.5 s are a static establishing shot with the product small and half hidden (H1, S1, F4), and there is no face (H4).

beats.what: Static wide living room, the ride-on toy half under the table; red words one by one
beats.why: A mystery object and a question

beats.what: Close on the box "Multi-Functional Ride-on 5-in-1", then the toy with a UNO logo
A boy about 4 walks to the toy and rides it; dissolves between takes
He rides in a hallway and bounces; "קלה" in red
beats.why: Adds light weight in a new room

beats.what: A hand lifts the top to show the hidden compartment; he puts toy cars in
beats.why: The hidden feature, held back until mid-Reel

beats.what: He rocks on the top part alone, in the living room
beats.why: Second use from the same product

beats.what: He lies on the bottom piece and crawls on it; "הפכנו למשחק"
beats.why: A third use, a playful turn

beats.what: He sits by the open tray of cars; where to buy; "זה לא סתם בימבה נכון?"
beats.why: Wrap-up and where to find it

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: A rhetorical question in the voice ("זה לא סתם בימבה נכון?") and the caption ("מגניב נכון?"), both closed. The caption's twins tip (join two ride-ons) is sendable; no ask.
q2_flow.why: The question opens a loop closed in 4 s (H5), and "בואו תראו מה היא עוד" holds the compartment back to 0:15 (R3). A new mode every 3 to 6 s moves the middle (R3, E2). The 4.5 s static opening is the slow part (R1), and it stops soon after the last mode (E8).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and subtitled 0:31 to 0:34: "ואם תרצו להשיג", "אותה תיכנסו לאתר", "או", "הנבחרות" (the site or selected stores). Caption: no ask, no link, price or code.
q3_cta.why: One where-to-buy action, said and shown after the value (C6, C1). But it names no site or price, and the subtitle sits in the lower band (C6, T4). The caption adds nothing to it, so a viewer who wants one has no clear route.

q4_shown.what: The ride-on toy half hidden at 0:00; the box and a UNO logo at 0:04; a boy about 4 riding it, a hand opening its compartment, cars stored, rocking on the top, lying on the bottom piece, then beside the open tray. No price.
q4_shown.why: Each mode is shown in use as the voice names it, so the claims are checkable (R3, K4). The toy is handled only from 0:07 (S1), and the logo reads UNO while the subtitle says "וילי". The child's face and name, written in subtitles twice, are what S5 warns about.

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 35 s (first pass), about 3.5 s each, mostly cross-dissolves between takes. A slow push-in on the first shot. Subtitles change every 1 to 2 s, one red word at times. The last frame blurs.
q5_edit.why: Dissolves and steady frames give a calm pace that suits one product in one home (E2). Subtitles follow the voiceover, so it works muted (E4, T1). Single red words give the key point at a glance (T2, T5), but the Reel ends on a blurred frame.

q6_topic.what: A multi-use ride-on toy that rides, stores toys, rocks and flips into a play tray, shown indoors; it serves parents choosing a first ride-on for a small home.
q6_topic.why: A practical parent concern: a toy that works indoors and stores things (K6, K4). The twins tip in the caption is a niche moment someone could send (R5). The mood is light and playful, not a strong peak (K1), and no occasion is named (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Mostly fixed phone shots in soft daylight: a static wide of a styled living room, slow push-in; eye-level mediums of the boy in a living room and tiled hallway; a top-down close-up of hands opening the compartment; a low handheld shot of him crawling.
q7_filmed.why: Steady, evenly lit frames look sharp and calm (F7, E6), and the top-down close-up of the compartment is clear, from the viewer's side (F5, F4). The wide opening makes the product small (F4). The styled interior looks more polished than a quick home clip (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: Large red single words, one per second, centred about 83% down the frame: 0:00 "שם", 0:01 "אקססוריז", 0:02 "חדש?", 0:03 "הבימבה", then the child's name. White subtitle lines follow with one red word: 0:13 "קלה", 0:18 "לחטיף", 0:24 "מגניבה", 0:31 "ואם תרצו להשיג".
q8_text.caption: "תקשיבו לי טוב כי אין יפה, איכותית ומגניבה כמו הבימבה הזו!!" About 31 words: a strong claim, "בימבה חמש ב-1", a twins tip, "מגניב נכון?". No hashtags, no CTA, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Big red words work as a headline read at a glance (T3, T5), and the subtitles make it work muted (T1, E4), but all text sits in the bottom band (T4, F2). The caption names the product and a shareable tip (T7, R5), with no hashtags and no disclosure of the collaboration (T7, T8, S7).

weak_points: A 4.5 s static opening with the product small and half hidden; the brand shown as UNO but subtitled "וילי"; two children's names in subtitles; no price, link or code; a generic where-to-buy; no disclosure.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a styled shelf with a book half hidden and a word-by-word question, then one hands-only close shot per feature with one key word in red.
not_verified: The brand (logo UNO, subtitle "וילי"); whose voice speaks, and whether the boy speaks at 0:32 (his mouth is open; audio not heard); the children's relation to the creator; music (not established); cut count from the first pass. The transcript mishears some words, so subtitles are quoted from frames.
